agent.summary: Reads Example Labs blog and Example Corp news and writes a roundup of what it found with a short summary of it.

steps.intent: Reads each of the sources you listed.
Writes a short summary of what came in, citing the items it is talking about.
Saves the whole roundup, with every item’s own address kept.

connections.label: Your model provider
connections.purpose: Lets you ask this agent questions about what it found. Any step you add later that needs a model can use this same connection too.

capabilities.label: Answer a question about what this agent found

fields.label: API key
fields.purpose: So DASH can reach this agent's model provider on its behalf.
fields.help: Your OpenRouter account has a keys page; a key made there is what DASH needs.

requirements.name: Your model provider
requirements.why: Without it this agent still collects what it finds and writes its digest; it just cannot answer questions about what it found.

read.label: Read the sources you choose
read.detail: Fetches the addresses listed in this agent's own sources file. It sends nothing and changes nothing.

write.label: Save a report inside its own folder
write.detail: Writes one file into the reports folder inside this agent's own folder, and nowhere else.

panel.title: What it found, and what it makes of it

sections.label: What it makes of this run
Every item in the latest digest
How this agent has been doing

acceptance.fixture: Two sources that answer with a well-formed feed.
acceptance.expect: The run completes and sends a digest and a brief, with every item carrying the address it came from.
The run completes and says there was nothing to read. It does not fail, and it does not send a document claiming to have found something.

acceptance.fixture: One source answers with an error and the other answers normally.
acceptance.expect: The run completes, the digest names the source that failed, and the items from the source that worked are all there. A partial result is reported as partial.

acceptance.fixture: Every brokered request is refused, the way DASH refuses one it has no key for.
acceptance.expect: The run completes with a complete digest and says it was not summarised. No operation outside the ones this agent's own manifest declares is ever asked for.
